name: Evanglessian
summary: Young human-led empire (founded by Velkya), steam, railways, elite military, airborne navy; open-minded melting pot; Tailemy is state religion.
relations: Dislike Paldoran pirates, oceanic ayodin, Hauds; good with Izedans, Dalvozzeans.

name: Dalvozzean
summary: Farishtaa-ruled caste nation in the High Rilausian Forest; capital Daion (white towers above canopy, slums below); ruled by the Nine Wings of Divinity (Day Society).
relations: Tension with Hauds (Siyesh) and Izedans; courteous to rare ayodin/Paldorans.

name: Izedan
summary: Desert nomad scavengers (the Quist), caravans, ritual scarification, steam crossbows; pale/bleach-white skin, often bald.
relations: Bad with Hauds; good with Valdru gnomes, satyrs; fascinated by ayodin.

name: Paldoran Exile
summary: Radiation-ravaged homeland (aether resonators); people live on giant Stormships, raid for supplies; Infernal Jinzium church.
relations: Shunned widely; hostile with saltwater ayodin; wary of Zel Hauds; best welcome in Evangless.

name: Zel Haud
summary: Industrial Haudi province Zelhost (Archduke Zimarati), matriarchal, very tall people; semi-independent of the Empress in Siyesh.
relations: Elitist toward neighbors; legacy of satyr slavery.
